lines.zh: 我一步踏下去，泥都陷了。
lines.en: I plant a foot and the mud sinks.

lines.zh: 三格高，走过去像一堵墙在动。
lines.en: Three blocks tall. A wall walking past.
I wade out of the marsh.
All that's on me rattles as I go.
I head toward the wood.
In the dark wood I'm the tall one.

lines.zh: 我绕过树，树还不到我腰。
lines.en: I go round a tree. It's below my waist.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但每一步都远。
lines.en: I'm not quick, but every step is long.

lines.zh: 我顺着臭味，慢慢挪过沼泽。
lines.en: Following the stench, I lumber across the swamp.

lines.zh: 主人让我去哪，我就去哪。
lines.en: Where my master bids, I go.
Call me to the field and I'll plough.

lines.zh: 我换个方向走，袋子一晃。
lines.en: I change direction; the sack sways.
I stand. A little taller than the trees.
The marsh fog reaches only my knees.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，让泥水从背上流。
lines.en: I bend down and let the muddy water run off my back.
Only then can I see the ground.
I reach down and pick something up.

lines.zh: 这一片地，被我踩得很实。
lines.en: This ground has been packed by my feet.
I'm not clever.
But I'm sturdy.
I'm waiting to be told.

lines.zh: 叫我做什么，我就做什么。
lines.en: Whatever I'm told, I do.

lines.zh: 这地方的味道，我习惯了。
lines.en: I'm used to the smell here.
What's on me, I ignore.
It makes its own noise.
I lift my heavy head.
Three blocks tall, I look down at you.

lines.zh: 我得弯下腰才看得见你。
lines.en: I must stoop to see you.
Are you my master?
If so, I follow.
I walk loudly. You'll hear me.
I'm not pleasant to look at. I know.
But I can work.
Ploughing, hauling. Either.
I'm not weak.
Mind my feet.
One step back and you're safe.
That's better now.

lines.zh: 我这一身，堆得乱七八糟。
lines.en: This body of mine is piled in a mess.
My head is low. Speak.
I'm listening. You may speak.
I'm standing here. I'll stand by.

lines.zh: 这一下，打在我厚的地方。
lines.en: That hit the thickest part of me.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，泥地上留下深坑。
lines.en: I step back, leaving a deep pit in the mud.
Another piece just fell off me.
It hit the thick part. I don't feel much.
I bend over and take a breath.
Bent over, but still standing.
This big, I'm poor at dodging.
But I can take hits.

lines.zh: 我撑着膝盖，慢慢把腰直起来。
lines.en: Bracing my knees, I slowly straighten up.
Master, I'm fine.
I'll eat this one.
I bend and sniff at it.

lines.zh: 这味道一般，可我还是想吃。
lines.en: It smells mediocre, but I still want it.

lines.zh: 味道不怎么样，我不挑食。
lines.en: It doesn't taste good. I'm not picky.

lines.zh: 这么点粪便，我一口就吞了。
lines.en: So little dung, I swallow it in one bite.
That little? Not enough.
Is there more on the ground.
I pick it up with a hand.
Enough for a day's work.
After this I'll walk on.
After eating, there's work.
Off to work. Coming along?

lines.zh: 你撞上我的腿，自己弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my leg and bounce off by yourself.
I turn and the soil turns up.
I lift a foot and set it down slowly.
Nearly stepped on you.

lines.zh: 我挪开半步，地面跟着晃。
lines.en: I shift half a step, and the ground shakes.
The trees are thick. The path is narrow.
You go first. I'll follow.
I'll walk behind you.
Then we won't collide.
You halt, and I plant myself.
Something like me isn't really suited.
But I'm willing to follow you.
You ahead. Me behind.
In the marsh I can block the wind.
At night I'll sit beside you.
I make noises. Don't be alarmed.
An old habit.
At dawn we walk on.
Any direction. Anywhere.
Which way — your call.
I bend and pick it up slowly.
Pinched between my fingers, it's small.
I squeeze gently, afraid to break it.
I put it in my master's pocket.
Too heavy for you. I'll carry it.
I tuck it under my arm.

lines.zh: 我弯腰把地上那堆拢起来。
lines.en: I bend down and gather the pile on the ground.
I'll move it all at once.
All moved. Where do these go?
Name a place.

lines.zh: 前面的芦苇在动，我停下来。
lines.en: The reeds ahead are moving; I stop.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，脖子发出泥响。
lines.en: I raise my head, my neck squelching with mud.
Master, get behind me.
I spread my arms and block the way.
I'm big. I'll hold.
To get through, it goes through me.
I'm not fast, but I don't yield.
I have something in my hand.
Lift it up.
Swing the arm. Throw.
That one went wide.
There's more. Throw again.
I keep facing that way.

lines.zh: 它转到哪边，我的头就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever it circles, my head follows.
I can't turn fast, but I can block.
I've got it cornered by a tree.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把影子压过去。
lines.en: Step by step, I press my shadow over it.
Hand up, ready to throw.
This one will land.
I raised my hand. It dodged.
I'll pick up more from the ground.

lines.zh: 地上散着粪便，我先记着。
lines.en: Dung lies scattered about; I will remember it.
I could throw all day.

lines.zh: 它往后退，我往前压一步。
lines.en: It retreats; I press one step forward.
I fling what's in my hand.
It splatters across it.

lines.zh: 我抬手又拍了一下，泥浆四溅。
lines.en: I swing again, splattering mud everywhere.
This handful flies truer.
I sweep an arm across.
It's knocked to the ground.
I lift a foot — and don't bring it down.
My master didn't say to kill.
So I just hold it down.
Pinned under me. It can't move.
I'm not even pressing.
I hold it. Waiting for orders.
I straighten up out of the marsh.
Water only reaches my shins.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩手，泥掉了一地。
lines.en: I shake my hands; mud scatters.
This wood can hold me.
I'm taller than any tree here.
First I lower my head to the ground.

lines.zh: 我从泥里站起来，压平一片芦苇。
lines.en: I rise from the mud, flattening a patch of reeds.
I swing my body round.
This shaggy coat blocks the wind.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽里趟出来，三格高的身子朝那边走。
lines.en: I wade out of the swamp, three blocks tall, and head over.
One stride covers it.
Standing here. I await orders.
Fire caught me. A burnt smell.

lines.zh: 三格高的身子，落地一个坑。
lines.en: Three blocks of body leave a crater.

lines.zh: 泥水漫到胸口，我一步一步挪。
lines.en: Muddy water to my chest. I move step by step.

lines.zh: 震得我身上掉了一大片。
lines.en: The blast took a big piece off me.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我手臂，不深。
lines.en: Something's in my arm. Not deep.

lines.zh: 那光一过，我身上全散了。
lines.en: That light passed and I came loose all over.
Two days without food. My legs are heavy.

lines.zh: 我这一身烂泥，导电得很。
lines.en: All this muck on me conducts rather well.
No mud here. No trees.
